task.description:
Update documentation after PD-09 is released.

1. **`docs/status/requirement_status.json`** — update the `PD-09` entry:
   ```json
   "PD-09": {
     "status": "RELEASED",
     "stage": 2,
     "priority": "SHOULD",
     "title": "Definition import/export",
     "implemented_in": ["src/definition/export_import.zig", "src/api/routes/definitions.zig"],
     "test_spec": "tests/specs/PD-09.md",
     "test_run": "WF02-pd09-20260521-run-01",
     "tested_at": "2026-05-21",
     "released_at": "2026-05-21",
     "release_run": "WF02-pd09-20260521",
     "last_updated": "<ISO8601 timestamp>"
   }
   ```

2. **`CHANGELOG.md`** — prepend a new entry under `## [Unreleased]` (or create the section if missing):
   ```markdown
   ### Added — PD-09 Definition import/export (2026-05-21)
   - New `src/definition/export_import.zig`: `ExportImportStore` providing `exportDefinition()` and `importDefinition()` for migrating definitions between environments.
   - `exportDefinition()` produces a self-contained `ExportDocument` JSON with `bpm_export_schema_version = "bpm/definition/v1"`, all definition fields, and the full graph; works for definitions in any status.
   - `importDefinition()` validates schema version, checks name+version uniqueness (HTTP 409 on conflict), re-validates CEL conditions via `validateEdgeConditions()` (HTTP 422 on invalid CEL), then creates the definition with `status = DRAFT`.
   - New HTTP handlers `handleExport` and `handleImport` added to `src/api/routes/definitions.zig`.
   - `src/bpm.zig` now exports `pub const export_import`.
   ```

3. Update `handoffs/registry.json` — set status of entry `99100006-2605-4000-8009-202605210805` to `COMPLETED`.

4. Set this handoff's own `status` to `COMPLETED` and fill `result` and `completed_at`.
acceptance_criteria: docs/status/requirement_status.json PD-09 entry has status RELEASED
CHANGELOG.md has a new PD-09 entry

result.summary: Updated PD-09 to RELEASED in docs/status/requirement_status.json; added PD-09 changelog entry under [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md
